subject.title: fix: generated images do not appear in native chat

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared native artifact-ticket download contract as the supported authorization boundary for transcript-backed generated images?
rationale: The implementation fixes an established rendering bug, but it also defines the long-lived security and compatibility contract between Gateway transcript authorization and three native clients.

options.title: Approve the ticket boundary after native proof
options.body: Keep the shared artifact-ticket design, require redacted paired-Gateway proof on native chat, and merge only after the remaining platform checks are green.

options.title: Request a narrower contract
options.body: Pause this branch and specify a different common native-media authorization API before accepting new transport and Gateway protocol surface.

options.title: Keep web-only behavior
options.body: Decline native managed-image loading for now and leave the existing native limitation in place.

recommendation.title: Approve the ticket boundary after native proof
recommendation.body: Keep the shared artifact-ticket design, require redacted paired-Gateway proof on native chat, and merge only after the remaining platform checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior implementation and investigation cover the original native managed-image boundary that this PR replaces.
